scope: E2E helper unit procedures. All children and port allocation are mocked; no network or campaign credit.

cases.oracle: Different full-piece starts/ends/hashes, explicit diagnostic seed, no challenge or isolation claim.
Unrelated original source sentinel survives constructor refusal.
Mock call order is Popen then registration before launch publication; returned identity and stop file preserved; raw binary streams and event path distinct.
Failed registration raises while retaining the actual Popen object and a failure action record.
Known formatted console line skipped; arbitrary malformed complete output fails.
Complete invalid lines are fatal while process is running, including duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers.
A concurrent incomplete tail becomes an error after ordinary zero exit.
The raw bytes remain unchanged and final-tail offset/length/reason are recorded.
Dedicated structured stream rejects wrong proc label, descending monotonic timestamp and console contamination.
Test-created product output is read-only compared with exact source bytes; same-size corruption fails.
A renamed but still accessible source yields no source-isolation claim.
Mocked kill records intent then result with exact PID/time and expected platform exit code.
An already-exited ordinary child with code7 fails cleanup and remains in results.
Tracker termination has its own declaration/actions/expected platform code and is never labelled ordinary peer success.

remaining_gaps: Default generated fixtures are diagnostic and are not a fresh verifier-supplied challenge.
Source rename or absent original pathname is not an OS-enforced denial boundary; redistribution acceptance remains unproved.
Live registry/guardian kills, platform termination, stdout capture, and strict streams require recorded process validation.
The helper hashes with stdlib SHA-256; the campaign must also perform the plan's independent external file verification.
Actual process resource sampling injection is owned by the root CLI preparation task.
